description.content: Nova Store is a fully custom online shop built for a growing fashion brand. We replaced a slow, template-based site with a lightweight theme and a streamlined checkout.
Payment gateways and a delivery-service API were integrated, so orders are confirmed and shipped without manual work. Page load time dropped from 5.2s to 1.4s.
